scope: Hosted public HTTP smoke replay. The separate eleven-case local integration suite was not rerun on Render.

checks.name: Public backend health is reachable and temporary history is declared
Start healthy returns HTTP 202 and run ID
Healthy journey passes all five real HTTP steps and records one simulated payment
Hosted evidence contains actual responses and logs; synthetic token is redacted
Start checkout_500 returns HTTP 202 and run ID
Injected checkout HTTP 500 records zero payments and skips confirmation
Checkout incident provides investigation guidance without an automatic action
Start receipt_order_missing returns HTTP 202 and run ID
HTTP 200 with missing order produces a business-outcome incident and one payment
Diagnosis references captured evidence and proposes the bounded worker resume
Start receipt_order_missing returns HTTP 202 and run ID
Two missing-confirmation failures share a fingerprint and related-incident group
Recovery without explicit approval is rejected

detail.error: Explicit approval and the supported resume_receipt_worker action are required.

checks.name: Approved recovery verifies the original order and retains exactly one payment
Repeated approval is idempotent and returns the same recovery record
Incident resolves only after verified recovery; original failed run is preserved
Other session cannot read original runs/incidents and remains unaffected
Hosted metrics agree with four runs and one verified recovery
